capabilities.name: XLSX import
capabilities.description: Reads .xlsx files into the grid: cell values, shared strings, sheet selection, and column type inference.

capabilities.name: XLSX export
capabilities.description: Writes the grid to an .xlsx file: cell values, sheet names, and the "To Excel" context menu item.

capabilities.name: Formulas
capabilities.description: Imports formulas into the Formulas plugin and exports live formulas instead of calculated values, including shared-formula translation.

capabilities.name: Sheet layout
capabilities.description: Column widths, row heights, hidden rows and columns, merged cells, frozen panes, right-to-left direction, and sheet state.

capabilities.name: Number formats
capabilities.description: Date, time, currency, percentage, and custom number formats on export. Import always reads number formats to infer cell types, so this token does not restrict import.

capabilities.name: Comments
capabilities.description: Cell comments, imported into the Comments plugin and exported with VML so they display in Excel.

capabilities.name: Import report
capabilities.description: The list of workbook features the import did not carry over, returned in the import result. Always produced, because it is also where a missing license token is reported.

capabilities.name: Cell styles
capabilities.description: Font, fill, borders, and alignment of cells and headers.

capabilities.name: Conditional formatting
capabilities.description: Conditional formatting rules: cellIs, expression, containsText family, top10, aboveAverage, and timePeriod.

capabilities.name: Data validation
capabilities.description: Dropdown lists from data validation rules, imported as dropdown cells and exported with a helper sheet for the list values.

capabilities.name: Sheet protection
capabilities.description: Locked cells and sheet protection with a SHA-512 password hash, imported as read-only cells and exported from read-only cells.
